Per our refund policy, full refunds can be requested within 14 calendar days of the charge date. Since you upgraded 5 days ago, your request falls within that window, so this is a case a manager can review and confirm for processing.

I've flagged your request for a manager to review and finalize — refunds are handled directly by them through our billing system, so I'm not able to process or confirm the amount myself. You should hear back shortly with the outcome.

Thanks for your patience!
